summary.name: Norton Genie
summary.one_liner: Norton Genie is a Norton (Gen) AI-powered scam protection assistant that aims to detect phishing, scam texts, fraudulent calls and deepfakes.
use_cases: check whether a text or call is a scam
screen suspicious messages in real time
add scam protection to a Norton 360 plan
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Norton Genie as an AI-powered scam protection product offering real-time protection against phishing, scam texts and fraudulent calls, now included in N360 plans. It includes a Norton Genie AI Assistant with a Deepfake Protection feature currently in early access, which supports only English YouTube videos. Automatic deepfake detection on Windows 11 requires specific hardware (AI PC or a 6-core non-AI PC with 16 GB RAM), while lesser PCs get manual scan only. The page footnotes also mention related Norton products such as Norton Family parental controls, a VPN, and LifeLock identity monitoring, with availability varying by country.
notable: Deepfake Protection in the Genie AI Assistant, in early access for English YouTube videos
Now bundled as part of N360 plans
Automatic deepfake detection needs Windows 11 and specific CPU/RAM; otherwise manual scan only
caveats: Deepfake protection is in early access and works only for English YouTube videos (automatic detection on other platforms requires manual scan)
Automatic deepfake detection requires Windows 11 and minimum hardware specs; Windows only, not S mode or ARM
Some features such as Location Supervision and LifeLock monitoring are not available in all countries
Requires an automatically renewing subscription for the antivirus-containing product
